input-field.name: loyaltyApiUrl
input-field.label: Loyalty API URL
input-field.helpText: Please ensure the URL starts with "https://app.loyaltyengage.tech".

input-field.name: maxLoyaltyProductsPerCart
input-field.label: Maximum Loyalty Products per Cart
Maximum loyalty producten per winkelmand
input-field.helpText: Maximum number of loyalty (free) products a customer can add per purchase. Set to 0 for unlimited.
Maximum aantal loyalty (gratis) producten dat een klant per aankoop kan toevoegen. Stel in op 0 voor onbeperkt.

card.title: Native loyalty shop and product feed

input-field.name: shopSourceFeedUrl
input-field.label: Loyalty Engage assortment feed URL
input-field.helpText: Private HTTPS URL on app.loyaltyengage.tech/feed/v1/. Used only in Loyalty Engage feed mode. Physical products are matched by SKU; reward type, coin price and discount values come from this feed.

input-field.name: shopVoucherPresentation
input-field.label: Presentation for vouchers without a Shopware product (JSON)
input-field.helpText: Optional map by SKU, for example {"DISCOUNT_PER_10":{"title":"10% korting","image":"https://example.com/voucher.jpg"}}. Without a title, the discount value is used. Prices always come from the source feed.

input-field.name: shopTiers
input-field.label: Loyalty Engage tiers, lowest to highest
input-field.helpText: One ID|name per line, for example 1|Brons. IDs must match this organization's Loyalty Engage tier IDs. Product minimum tier IDs are required when tiers are enabled.

input-field.name: shopFeedToken
input-field.label: Product feed access token (minimum 32 characters)
input-field.helpText: Use a randomly generated secret. Feed: /loyaltyshop/feed.ndjson?token=YOUR_TOKEN on the sales channel domain with the organization's default currency.

component.name: sw-entity-single-select
shopFeedCurrencyId
component.label: Feed currency (organization default currency)
component.helpText: Choose the default currency of your Loyalty Engage organization. If empty, the sales channel default currency is used.

input-field.name: srsVoucherCreationEnabled
input-field.label: Use SRS for discount code creation
input-field.helpText: Creates vouchers through prod.bridge.loyaltyengage.tech using the Loyalty Engage Client ID and Client Secret. Requires SRS Tenant ID. Product SKU must match the bridge voucher_type.

input-field.name: srsDiscountSyncEnabled
input-field.label: Enable SRS Discount Sync
input-field.helpText: When enabled, LoyaltyEngage discount codes are validated against the SRS API before being applied. If a code has already been redeemed, it will be rejected at checkout.

input-field.name: srsTenantId
input-field.label: SRS Tenant ID
input-field.helpText: Required when SRS voucher creation is enabled. Used for voucher creation, status checks and redemption.

input-field.name: srsClientId
input-field.label: SRS Client ID
input-field.helpText: Optional dedicated Basic Auth username/client ID for the Dev Bridge SRS endpoint. Falls back to the main Client ID when left empty.

input-field.name: srsClientSecret
input-field.label: SRS Client Secret
input-field.helpText: Optional dedicated Basic Auth password/client secret for the Dev Bridge SRS endpoint. Falls back to the main Client Secret when left empty.

input-field.name: srsPlatformKey
input-field.label: SRS Platform Key
input-field.helpText: Platform key for the Dev Bridge redeem-voucher endpoint (X-PLATFORM-KEY header).

input-field.name: srsBranchId
input-field.label: SRS Branch ID
input-field.helpText: Branch/filiaal ID used when redeeming the voucher in SRS (for example: 1).

input-field.name: pointsRedemptionEnabled
input-field.label: Enable Points Redemption
Punkte-Einlösung aktivieren
Punten inwisselen inschakelen
input-field.helpText: Allow customers to redeem loyalty points for discounts in checkout.
Ermöglicht Kunden, Treuepunkte gegen Rabatte im Checkout einzulösen.
Sta klanten toe om loyaliteitspunten in te wisselen voor korting in de checkout.

input-field.name: discountProductSku
input-field.label: Discount Product SKU
Rabattprodukt SKU
Kortingsproduct SKU
input-field.helpText: The SKU of the €1 discount product in LoyaltyEngage. This product will be purchased multiple times to create the discount.
Die SKU des €1 Rabattprodukts in LoyaltyEngage. Dieses Produkt wird mehrfach gekauft, um den Rabatt zu erstellen.
De SKU van het €1 kortingsproduct in LoyaltyEngage. Dit product wordt meerdere keren gekocht om de korting te creëren.

input-field.name: pointsPerEuro
input-field.label: Points per Euro
Punkte pro Euro
Punten per Euro
input-field.helpText: How many points are needed for €1 discount. Default: 1 point = €1.
Wie viele Punkte für €1 Rabatt benötigt werden. Standard: 1 Punkt = €1.
Hoeveel punten nodig zijn voor €1 korting. Standaard: 1 punt = €1.

input-field.name: minPointsToRedeem
input-field.label: Minimum Points to Redeem
Mindestpunkte zum Einlösen
Minimum punten om in te wisselen
input-field.helpText: Minimum number of points a customer must redeem at once.
Mindestanzahl an Punkten, die ein Kunde auf einmal einlösen muss.
Minimum aantal punten dat een klant in één keer moet inwisselen.

input-field.name: maxPointsPerOrder
input-field.label: Maximum Points per Order
Maximale Punkte pro Bestellung
Maximum punten per bestelling
input-field.helpText: Maximum number of points that can be redeemed per order. Set to 0 for unlimited.
Maximale Anzahl an Punkten, die pro Bestellung eingelöst werden können. 0 für unbegrenzt.
Maximum aantal punten dat per bestelling kan worden ingewisseld. Stel in op 0 voor onbeperkt.

input-field.name: maxDiscountPercentage
input-field.label: Maximum Discount Percentage
Maximaler Rabattprozentsatz
Maximum kortingspercentage
input-field.helpText: Maximum percentage of order total that can be paid with points. Set to 0 for unlimited.
Maximaler Prozentsatz des Bestellwerts, der mit Punkten bezahlt werden kann. 0 für unbegrenzt.
Maximum percentage van het ordertotaal dat met punten kan worden betaald. Stel in op 0 voor onbeperkt.
